lines.text: いちごのつぶつぶは、種じゃないって知ってた？
prompts: a bright red strawberry on a white wooden table, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a close-up of a ripe strawberry with tiny dots on its surface, bright daylight, simple storybook style

lines.text: あのつぶつぶ、実は一つひとつが「果実」なんだ。
prompts: many fresh strawberries in a wicker basket, bright sunny kitchen, cheerful storybook style
a magnifying glass over a strawberry showing tiny dots, bright cartoon

lines.text: 本当の種は、そのつぶつぶの中に入っているんだよ。
prompts: a cute cutaway cartoon of a tiny strawberry dot with a small seed inside, bright colors
a hand holding a strawberry in a sunny garden, bright daylight

lines.text: 私たちが食べている赤い部分は、花のつけ根がふくらんだものなんだって。
prompts: a white strawberry flower with green leaves in a sunny garden, bright daylight, storybook style
a strawberry plant with flowers and small red fruits, bright cheerful

lines.text: その部分は「花托」と呼ばれているよ。
prompts: a strawberry flower turning into a red strawberry, step by step cartoon, bright colors
a ripe red strawberry on a green plant in a bright strawberry field

lines.text: 甘いいちごは、花が育った姿だったのかもしれないね。
prompts: a farmer woman picking strawberries in a sunny field, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a strawberry field under a blue sky with white clouds, cheerful storybook style

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a cute smiling strawberry character waving at the camera, bright cheerful cartoon
